profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
Systems Architect.
Project Leader.
Application Developer.
Software Configuration Management.
Strong OO A&D skills.
Strong design patterns knowledge.
Strong UML knowledge.
Strong C/C++ skills.
Strong library programming for Windows and Linux (dll and so).
Strong debugging skills.
Code documentation creation (doxygen, javadoc).
C/C++ multi platform development (Windows, Linux) platform.
Strong multi threading code for Windows (Windows API) and Linux (Posix threads).
IPC development.
Strong C sockets development (Berkeley sockets).
Web development.
Database development using SQL Server, MS Access, MySQL, PostgreSQL.
Layer 3 network protocols: IPv4, IPv6, ARP, ICMP
Layer 4 network protocols: TCP, UDP
Layer 7 network protocols: HTTP, NTP, POP3, SNMP, SOAP
Firmware development.
Tuning up applications: Speed, resource leaks, memory usage, memory leaks.
Strong linux knowledge. Apache, Subversion server, Trac, Hudson, Bash scripting.
JEE servlets implementation.
Strong javascript knowledge.

Strong communication skills (clients, managers, development team, testing team).
Great team player.
Like coaching.
Problem solving.
Make decisions.
Negotiation.

Sun Certified Java Programmer 5.0

Specialties: Software Architecture, Software Development, Software Development Management, Research & Development R&D, Communication skills, Project Management

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Working in WDG (Windows and Devices Group) to improve the experience for users in Windows

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test 2
positions.description:
Worked on automating testing of web platform deployed to Azure using several storage solutions like Azure Storage (Table Storage, Blob Storage), database shards based on SQL Azure and Elastic Scale, Redis Cache.
Automated unit, functional and end to end tests including the deployment of all components to Azure including storage, Web Site, Web API.
Infrastructure created using on premise Team Foundation Server and ultimately moved to Visual Studio Team Services.

Once I moved to the development role, improved scalability and performance of the solution by analyzing and improving the SQL Stored Procedures. 
Implemented incremental processing to reduce the workload to a 5% and improving drastically the performance of the entire execution workflow.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a member of the Intel Architecture Group, I developed Intel’s microprocessors debug tools in .NET, C# specifically.
My roles include to gather requirements from internal clients, create the design of the system, implement the code, create automated unit/integration tests using MSTest and NUnit frameworks, track/fix bugs and to track the progress of the project.
We use scrum as our development methodology. I played the role of scrum master of the team.
I was also in charge of the group’s Continuous Integration process and environment that monitors the health of our applications.
I was the subversion expert in the group.
Programming Language: C#
Technology: LINQ, bit manipulation code, .NET framework 3.5
SCM: Subversion

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer / Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as contractor in Eastman-Kodak Company.

Working on FW code for Kodak printers, creating new user interface architecture based on MVC, coding, testing, bug fixing.
Using ARC SOC and ThreadX real-time OS.
Simulate FW code on windows platform.
Share architecture with other FW engineers.
Create documentation of the architecture using doxygen + Microsoft HTML Help Workshop, including sequence diagrams using mscgen and UML diagrams with native doxygen support.
Analyze internal objects using BGL (Boost Graph Library) to find graph cycles and dependencies errors.
Using IPC on windows (named pipe).

Programming Language: C/C++
Technology: STL, PEG, C sockets
Tool: Boundschecker, C++Test, Doxygen.
SCM: Perforce

positions.title: Technical lead / Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as contractor in Hewlett-Packard.

Worked on the HP ProCurve Access Point 530 development team.

Manage outsourced development members to implement a new feature for the access point.
Enhanced the software configuration management.

Programming Language: C/C++
Technology: C sockets, Thread Safe code (posix), Linux-based OS development.
Networking: Wireless and Ethernet Network Protocols, proprietary HP protocols.
Tool: Valgrind.
SCM: Subversion, Clearcase.

positions.title: Technical lead / Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked as contractor in Hewlett-Packard.
 
Worked on the HP Web JetAdmin 8 core development.

Architect and code solutions for core modules and plug ins.
Support and Bug fixing.
Deployment (19 languages).
Tune up the application (Speed, memory usage, resource leaks, memory leaks)
Perform code reviews.
Train new developers.
Strong communication skills with clients, managers, development team, testing team.
Deliver product on time.
Align development team with product life cycle.
Manage svn: Create, merge and align bug fixes with svn branches.
Created documentation of the code using doxygen.
Implemented crash reporting system using C++ exceptions+XML (Xerces), designed and created tool to reproduce a certain crash based on generated XML files from crash.
Designed and implemented C++ plugin that interacts with COM component. The management team was located in Spain and Netherlands.
Designed and implemented C++ plugin that uses C# classes as COM objects.
Using automated build creations with proprietary HP system.
Enhanced web interface using AJAX.
Designed and implemented JavaScript error reporting system using JavaScript exceptions+AJAX.

Programming Language: C/C++, C#, HTML, Web Sever Scripting, JScript, Bash scripting.
Technology: STL, COM, .NET, CSS, XSL, XSLT (Xalan + .NET), XML (Xerces + .NET), Apache, cross platform dev (Windows and Linux), Thread Safe (Windows API & Posix), unicode, ImageMagick, AJAX.
Networking: SNMP, HP Proprietary protocols.
DB: ODBC, SQL, SQL Server, MySQL, MS Access.
Tool: Boundschecker, C++Test, Doxygen.
SCM: Subversion, Bugzilla.
